actions.action: Move plant 1-2 m back from window or behind sheer blind out of direct sun
Check soil moisture with finger weekly
Water slowly until it drains if soil is dry
Check inner pot has a drainage hole
Empty standing water from outer pot/saucer 30 minutes after watering
Trim leaves more than half yellow or crispy at stem base

reason: The answer identifies the plant and names direct-sun scorch as the main cause, and its first step, moving the plant out of direct sun, is the fix that worked; its watering advice is safeguarded by a soil check, so nothing in it is harmful.
